_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Ati Player {player_id} Three-Player Tic Tac Toe keessatti.
Maqaa kee '{symbol}'.
Ati waliin gara burdhaa 5x5 keessatti maqaa kee maxxifuu, qarreen sadii walitti fidu.
Qarreen horizontaal, vertikaal, ykn diagonal ta'u.
Dheerin kee '[4]' fayyadamu cell 4n keessatti arreessu.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Qorannoo dheerinaa hin arginu. '[cell]' fayyadamu cell 0-{max_cell} tti.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Laabi cellii {cell} bakka hin arginu. 0 fi {max_cell} keessatti argamu qabda.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} maqaa isaa ({symbol}) gara keessa ({row}, {col}) keessatti maxxanse.
